_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. an environment sheet of an abandoned cedar mill: a long sagging shed, a brick smokestack, blackberry over the loading dock, a rusted chain across the drive; interior with light in long bars through missing roof panels onto a rusted saw and sawdust; inset: a small cedar sapling growing from the smokestack's rim; labeled THE CEDAR MILL. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
